snapshot.figCaption: zero’s real layout, redrawn. Names and subjects are made up.
snapshot.srOnly: Illustration of zero’s Open loops panel: 416 things still need you across 2 Gmail accounts. A “Waiting on you” list shows each conversation’s sender, subject, an Action required or Needs reply tag, its age, and Reply, AI archive and Archive actions. A Run zero now button sits at the bottom.
snapshot.footText: Tidies every inbox to only what needs you.
